description: We are a team of students and our mentor, united by a shared passion for science, technology, mathematics, physics, and chemistry. We love exploring how our own world works, and we see this challenge as the perfect opportunity to discover how outer space and other worlds operate. We are eager to participate, learn from the community, and let our creativity soar
summary: Start bit is an online game for kids aged 7–12. Using real NASA data and AI-generated HTML/CSS/JS, it teaches real lunar and Martian survival challenges through critical decision-making.
details:
Start bit is an online game built with HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.

Aimed at children aged 7 to 12, the game is designed to help them understand the challenges of space exploration and colonization using real NASA data.

It explains these concepts and challenges in a simple way, helping kids get engaged, learn, and push themselves by solving puzzles and unexpected scenarios. As they play, they progressively learn more about the difficulties of exploring other planets and moons.

After creating various sketches and gathering data from official NASA websites, we crafted a series of prompts for Claude to build the game.
